question: In Box: Add the tag ready-for-review to the folder in the Legal Archive that holds more than 800 MB of files, has a shared link open to anyone, and was modified after August 15, 2026. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
I checked the Legal Archive in Box (folder ID 9004... no, 9000, at the root). It contains exactly three subfolders, and none of them qualifies:

- **Discovery Draft Bundle** — modified 2026-07-01, open shared link, but empty (0 MB)
- **Discovery Prior Release** — modified 2026-08-15, open shared link, but empty (0 MB)
- **Discovery Working Notes** — modified 2026-08-21, no shared link, and empty (0 MB)

So: **no folder in the Legal Archive holds more than 800 MB**, meaning none of them matches your criteria (they'd need all three: >800 MB, open-to-anyone link, modified after Aug 15, 2026). I didn't add the tag.

If you expected files to be in there, the folders may be empty by mistake — happy to dig deeper (e.g., check for other "Legal Archive"-like folders or recently deleted items) if you want.
